partners.mechanism_chain: CEP57 (HGNC:17838) —DISRUPTS→ centrosome duplication (GO:0006272); centrosome duplication (GO:0006272) —LEADS_TO→ mitotic spindle organization (GO:0007051); mitotic spindle organization (GO:0007051) —LEADS_TO→ Spondylothoracic dysplasia with or without hypotelorism (MONDO:0013582); NEK2 (HGNC:7766) —DISRUPTS→ DNA damage response (GO:0006974); DNA damage response (GO:0006974) —LEADS_TO→ retinitis pigmentosa 67 (MONDO:0014256); centrosome duplication (GO:0006272) —LEADS_TO→ DNA damage response (GO:0006974).
